Hi Emily — great to meet you over chat earlier. Ben will help run the session; Marissa is on CS in case we surface pilot questions.

We hear you on keeping it tight. One pattern we've been using for inbound handoffs is a pair of compact demo "blocks" instead of a single 30-min run:

1) Block A — 12–15 min: product tour focused on the widget-to-SDR path, key telemetry you can surface, and where caching/batching helps cost.
2) Block B — 10–12 min: integration checklist + next-steps (kickoff pilot, data onboarding, SLA needs).

If that sounds good, here are a few windows (EDT):
- Fri 2026-11-27 10:00–10:30
- Fri 2026-11-27 14:00–14:30
- Tue 2026-12-01 09:30–10:00

I attached a one-page agenda to keep us on track (brief-agenda.pdf). If you'd prefer a single contiguous 30-minute session we can do that as well. Also, here's a Calendly if you want to pick: https://calendly.com/redwood-inference/30min-demo
